arithmetic_notes: For the phase cell use P=N*k+r and N*delta=1. The robust scaled identity is P*delta = k + r*delta.
The upper phase bound follows from t <= (k+1-delta)/P. Prove delta is below this from r+1<=N; prove the second max argument is below it from P*(N-2-M)>=M*(N-1) and r>=0.
Use t>=A and P-M>0 for the lower phase. Retain all divisions as Real divisions; do not use Nat division for t.
The manuscript's assumption M<N-2 is required for positivity of N-2-M. The actual runner count N=A.card+B.card+2 must remain explicit and must not be replaced by M.
semantic_uncertainties_and_limits: The candidate manuscript is explicitly pending independent review, so this inventory is not an endorsement or a theorem claim.
The proposed general phase-cell theorem must state whether its high-coordinate parameter includes i=0; the manuscript does include it to cover P.
For arbitrary A and B, reflection maps T(A,B) to T(B,A), not necessarily to itself; a proof must carry the swapped configuration explicitly.
Cardinality needs the stated subset and p>=2M+1 assumptions to exclude zero/image collisions and lower/upper overlap.
No exact iff or necessity statement is needed for the first formalization; the sufficient large-P contract is the lower-risk target.
